verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say it captures receipts at swipe and auto-fills memos and categories (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-45), codes expenses to the correct GL account (ramp-docs-32), and offers memo suggestions via the CLI. For auditing, Ramp Intelligence agents flag fraud, scan transactions in real time for anomalies, and flag questionable vendors (ramp-docs-21, ramp-supp-ramp-agents-product, ramp-docs-48), and bill-pay OCR reads line items (ramp-docs-16). Missing for 10: explicit duplicate-expense detection, in-depth technical docs on how receipt reading and coding work (current evidence is mostly marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
